title: Became again a child’s soul
html_source: Recall Stephen’s actions at the end of the second chapter and his thoughts at the beginning of this one, considering his “sins.” Here, he seems to abandon the weights of his “sins"—for a moment at least—upon seeing "Father Arnall.”
